caption:
Every day deserves a report. The HealthGraph daily report opens like a paper card: pulse 59 BPM, fair, at 5:14 PM; fingertip 61 BPM; eight entries logged; six logs one tap away. No scrolling through apps, one page per day, in order. #HealthGraph #DailyReport #HealthDiary #HealthHistory #Pulse #SelfTracking #HealthData #Wellness #Longitudinal #PersonalData

lines.text: What happened to my health on Tuesday?
lines.beat: Question overlays the dimmed daily-report list; the cream paper card 3 OCT Today waits behind, slightly out of focus

lines.text: On HealthGraph, the answer is a daily report.
lines.beat: The real daily-report paper card, 3 OCT Today, Daily Report Saturday October 3, lifts and faces the camera; user name cropped

lines.text: Open it, and the day lays itself out.
lines.beat: The paper report opens with a page motion, revealing the real daily-report layout

lines.text: Pulse: 59 beats per minute, fair, at 5:14 PM.
lines.beat: Focus on the real Pulse 59 BPM Fair 5:14 PM line on the open paper card

lines.text: Plus a fingertip reading: 61 beats, also fair.
lines.beat: Focus slides to the real ALSO Pulse Fingertip 61 BPM Fair line, same open report

lines.text: Eight entries were logged that day.
lines.beat: Top stats settle in above the card: 8 entries logged, 0 records, 0 observations, from the real daily-report screen

lines.text: Six logs sit behind it, one tap away.
lines.beat: Footer Log ×6, tap to open gets tapped; a soft ring pulse confirms the tap

lines.text: No scrolling through apps. One page per day.
lines.beat: Quick pass over the real daily-report list tabs All, Daily Logs, Records, Symptoms, then back to the single card

lines.text: That's what a day of health looks like, told in full.
lines.beat: The open paper report holds centered, October 2026, 1 of 1 header visible, warm light on the cream card
